fullContentHtml:
Bihar Police CSBC Constable Final Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) has released the final result for the post of Constable. This recruitment was released for 19,838 posts. Applications for the Bihar Police CSBC Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from March 18, 2025, to April 25, 2025. The PET examination was held on 15 December 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Bihar Police CSBC Constable Final Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 11 March 2025
  • Application Start Date : 18 March 2025
  • Last Date : 25 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 April 2025
  • Exam Date : 16, 20, 23, 27, 30 July & 03 August 2025
  • Exam City Details : 20 May 2025
  • Admit Card : 09 July 2025
  • Result Available : 26 September 2025
  • PET Exam Date : 15 December 2025
  • PET Admit Card : 25 November 2025
  • Final Result : 27 May 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EBS, BC : Rs. 675/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 180/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
